title: Bow Pearl iPhone Charger Case Set
description_text: Description: Elevate your charging style with our Bow Pearl iPhone Charger Case Set. Featuring a glittery white base with delicate mini bow designs and pearl accents, this charger case transforms your regular adapter into a fashionable accessory. The set includes a matching cable cover and a stylish scrunchie-inspired cord protector, combining elegance with functionality. Durable, protective, and absolutely aesthetic—perfect for keeping your charger safe while adding a luxe touch to your everyday essentials.
